title: Paper title
main_caveat: Replace with the public caveat or state that no caveat is known.
human_summary: Replace with a concise public-facing note; leave empty for formalized papers unless a source-version or proof-route note matters.

human_summary_review.note: Set to human_written after a human writes this summary, or human_approved after explicit human approval; do not rewrite a human_written or human_approved summary without explicit human instruction.

human_review.source: paper-local status.json review_surface; human entries come from dashboard logs

llm_statement_review.policy: Translate each Lean statement with an LLM that has no paper context and require it to preserve every visible binder, hypothesis, domain condition, named predicate/wrapper application, equivalence direction, conclusion, and visible input. Have an independent semantic LLM judge compare that TeX/prose translation with the original full paper statement, not just the theorem label or phrase. A `matches` verdict requires equivalence of hypotheses, subparts, quantifiers, domains, constants, normalizations, signs, inequality directions, conclusions, and the semantics of every Lean premise. If a Lean premise is a named predicate or wrapper, the judge must inspect what that predicate means in the paper model; source-looking names are not evidence. Extra replay, certificate, process, bridge, source-row, or broad package assumptions must be judged `mismatch` or `uncertain` unless explicitly source-backed or derived from source primitives. Record the model/agent validator metadata and iterate on PaperInterface.lean until the full statement matches. If the dashboard has more than 30 rows, run a no-paper-context LLM audit that checks whether every row is paper-facing; at 120 or more rows, curate the surface before broad human review.

llm_paper_coverage_review.policy: Maintain a paper_statement_map.json inventory of source definitions, formulas, and named statements, then use a separate source-grounded LLM pass to judge whether each source item is semantically covered by one or more dashboard rows. Source-to-dashboard links do not count unless the linked rows also have current row-local statement-match judgments.

llm_assumption_review.policy: Every paper-facing theorem premise not derived from prior Lean declarations must be declared in Assumptions.lean, listed in assumption_names, and judged by an independent LLM as a true paper/source model assumption rather than a proof assumption.

llm_source_record_review.policy: Run the code-backed recursive source-record audit for any visible record, certificate, replay, process, bridge, source-row, or broad package premise. The LLM judge must classify each boundary-shaped input and recursive field by source evidence, Lean derivation, approved external boundary, or unresolved proof debt.
